text_blocks.snippet: No, leukemia is not typically classified as an autoimmune disease. While leukemia involves the immune system, it's a cancer where abnormal white blood cells proliferate, not an attack on the body's own healthy cells. However, autoimmune complications can occur in some types of leukemia, such as chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL), where the immune system may mistakenly target the body's own red blood cells or other tissues.
